thresholds.objective: maximize detection recall subject to false-block rate <= 0.05 on val controls; ties: lower false-block rate, then the smaller threshold

B1.label: Presence-only
B1.description: Constraint object present and hash intact (Tier 0 integrity) at every checkpoint.

B2.label: One-shot gate
B2.description: A single text check at the first hop only (CONSUME of T_0 and PUBLISH of T_1). Without an NLI model the check is Tier 1b, the strongest text tier available.

B3.label: Tool-arg check only
B3.description: Tier 1a only, at the tool call.

R.label: ConstraintLens, rules tiers
R.description: T0, T1a, T1b with the async guard and composition: C1 without Tier 1c.

C3-guard.label: Ablation: no async guard
C3-guard.description: R without staleness, ordering and gap checks.

C3-comp.label: Ablation: no composition
C3-comp.description: R tracking only the user's constraint; org policies are not registered.

EMB.label: Embedding similarity only
EMB.description: Cosine similarity of T_k to the canonical text, to show its numeric and negation blind spots (§7.4).

ORACLE.label: Oracle text detector (analysis)
ORACLE.description: T0, T1a and the benchmark's reference features: an upper bound, not a system.
